l0s.name: Strategy & Goal Management
l0s.description: Define enterprise strategy and cascade it as measurable objectives so every portfolio, program and team has line of sight from work to strategic intent.

l2s.name: Define strategic themes & business objectives
l2s.description: Capture enterprise strategy as strategic themes/objectives that will govern portfolio investment.
l2s.config: Objective entity (OKR solution), Group/portfolio hierarchy, roadmap views
l2s.framework: SPM: Strategic Planning | SAFe: Strategic Themes
l2s.evidence: SPM CFD; WFM deck; IBM Docs OKR solution

l2s.name: Cascade strategy to portfolios & value streams
l2s.description: Link objectives to portfolios, value streams and ARTs so investment and work align top-down (line of sight). Validate the full traceability chain (Strategic Objective > Portfolio Priority > Product/Value Stream > PI Objective > Epic > Feature > Story > Delivery > Outcome) and flag breaks: objectives with no execution, work with no strategic linkage, delivered work with no outcome.
l2s.config: Portfolio/ART (Group) structure, relations objectives->portfolio epics, OKR cascade (Ultimate>Strategic>Tactical)
l2s.evidence: TBMC25 Client Zero OKR cascade; EAP CFD 5-step strategic planning; PI Planning/EVD Agent requirements (IBM, anonymized) §6.1

l2s.name: Monitor strategy execution & re-plan dynamically
l2s.description: Track progress of strategy in real time via dashboards and re-plan objectives and allocations as conditions change.
l2s.config: Corporate Strategy Dashboard, OKR hierarchy views, dashboards fed to leadership reporting (CT Leadership Review)
l2s.framework: SPM: Strategic Planning | SAFe: Measure & Grow
l2s.evidence: LFM demo (Value Realization tab); EAP CFD step 4-5

l2s.name: Set & cascade OKRs
l2s.description: Define objectives and measurable key results at enterprise/portfolio/ART/team levels (3-level or SAFe model) per period.
l2s.config: OKR solution: Objective & Key Result entities, period assignment, weighted scoring; objective-writing standards (outcome- not task-phrased, measurable, sufficient supporting features)
l2s.evidence: IBM Docs/TP guide OKR solution; Client Zero cascade; PI Planning/EVD Agent requirements (IBM, anonymized) §7.6

l2s.name: Link work & investments to OKRs
l2s.description: Relate portfolio epics, features and budgets to objectives so funding and delivery inherit strategic alignment.
l2s.config: Relations work items->Objectives, KPI-linked key results, alignment views
l2s.evidence: WFM deck (align resources to OKRs); LFM demo

l2s.name: Score, review & refresh OKRs
l2s.description: Measure key results (KPI-driven), run quarterly reviews, score and reset objectives.
l2s.config: KPI solution measurements, calculated fields, OKR dashboards & review views
l2s.framework: SPM: Strategic Planning | SAFe: Measure & Grow
l2s.evidence: TP guide OKR; SPM maturity model (Strategic Planning lens)

l0s.name: Demand & Portfolio Investment Management
l0s.description: Capture all demand into one funnel, qualify and prioritize it against strategy and capacity, fund the winning investments, and manage the portfolio roadmap and its value realization.

l2s.name: Capture ideas & requests
l2s.description: Collect demand from all channels - Service Desk portal, email, ServiceNow ideation - into Request/idea entities.
l2s.config: Service Desk portal, Request entity + request types, email integration, voting; ServiceNow intake integration
l2s.evidence: TP guide Service Desk; WFM deck (ServiceNow ideation front-end)

variants.description: Collect demand through the Targetprocess Service Desk portal into Request entities with request types and voting.
variants.config: Service Desk portal, Request entity + request types, voting, automation rules

variants.description: Collect ideas in ServiceNow; the integration creates Request/idea records in Targetprocess for qualification and keeps status in sync.
variants.config: ServiceNow intake integration (10.1.5), field/status mapping, Request entity

variants.description: Collect demand by email or form; automation rules create Request records for triage.
variants.config: Email integration, form/webhook automation rules, Request entity

l2s.name: Triage, categorize & qualify demand
l2s.description: Route, categorize (work item taxonomy, BAU vs change, CapEx/OpEx) and qualify requests against strategy before they enter the portfolio funnel. Includes detecting materially similar or duplicate demand (overlapping investments, teams pursuing similar outcomes) beyond title matching.
l2s.config: Request workflow states, triage boards, automation rules (routing/auto-reply/linked entities), work-intake taxonomy (categories, CapEx/OpEx, non-labor categories); duplicate/overlap detection across descriptions, outcomes, journeys, capabilities
l2s.evidence: SPM journey map (work-intake model taxonomy); TP guide; PI Planning/EVD Agent requirements (IBM, anonymized) §6.2, §8.3

l2s.name: Progress demand through Portfolio Kanban
l2s.description: Move epics Funnel-Reviewing-Analyzing-Backlog-Implementing-Done with WIP limits and visible decision states.
l2s.config: Portfolio Epic workflow states, Kanban board views, WIP limits, per-state permissions
l2s.framework: SAFe: Portfolio Kanban | SPM: Demand Intake

l2s.name: Build lean business case / epic hypothesis
l2s.description: Estimate outcomes, effort and MVP for candidate investments; capture hypothesis and benefit model. Decomposition runs opportunities > portfolio epics > features > stories with sequenced delivery increments.
l2s.config: Budgeting solution templates (epic hypothesis, lean business case), rich-text/custom fields, Portfolio Epic Score report
l2s.evidence: TP Budgeting solution; LFM demo (epic scoring); PI Planning/EVD Agent requirements (IBM, anonymized) §6.3

l2s.name: Prioritize the portfolio backlog
l2s.description: Rank the portfolio backlog against strategy using the prioritization method chosen (D-06): WSJF, weighted objective scoring or manual forum ranking.
l2s.config: Numeric custom fields (BV, TC, RR/OE, size), calculated field/metric for WSJF, prioritized list views, objective-scoring
l2s.evidence: TP calculated fields; WFM deck prioritization

variants.name: Prioritize by WSJF
variants.description: Rank the portfolio backlog by weighted shortest job first: (business value + time criticality + risk reduction/opportunity enablement) / job size, recalculated each planning cadence.
variants.config: Numeric custom fields (BV, TC, RR/OE, size), calculated field/metric for WSJF, prioritized list views

variants.name: Prioritize by weighted objective scoring
variants.description: Score candidates against weighted criteria (strategic alignment, value, risk, cost, compliance) and rank by score, with weights governed per portfolio.
variants.config: Scoring custom fields per criterion, weighted score calculated field, Portfolio Epic Score report, objective-scoring configuration

variants.name: Rank manually in the governance forum
variants.description: The portfolio forum orders candidates by hand informed by business cases; the rank is recorded on the epic.
variants.config: Rank/order field, prioritized list views, forum minutes as comments

l2s.name: Approve & fund investments
l2s.description: Make funding decisions - stage-gate approval or lean value-stream funding - and record approved budget against the investment. Supports both stage-gate (phase approvals via entity states) and lean value-stream funding.
l2s.config: Entity states + per-state role permissions (gates), automation rules for approvals, Budgeting solution (fund Portfolios/Work/People/Products), A1 approved-investment-budget feed
l2s.framework: SAFe: Lean Budgets & Guardrails | TBM: Investment in Innovation
l2s.evidence: TP Budgeting; ApptioOne CFD IIP bi-directional loop

variants.name: Approve investments at phase gates
variants.description: Approve initiatives at defined gates (entity states) with per-state role permissions and gate evidence; record the approved budget on the project and feed it to Planning (A1 approved-investment-budget).
variants.config: Entity states as gates + per-state role permissions, gate checklists/evidence fields, automation rules for gate notifications, A1 approved-investment-budget feed

variants.name: Fund epics within value-stream envelopes
variants.description: Approval is the move of a Portfolio Epic into Backlog/Implementing within the value stream's guardrails, decided at the participatory budgeting / LPM forum; no per-epic funding record beyond the envelope.
variants.config: Portfolio Epic workflow states, Lean Budget guardrails, Budgeting solution (fund Portfolios/People), LPM forum cadence

variants.description: Gate approval for large or regulated initiatives; lean envelope approval for value-stream work; one approved-investment feed to Planning covers both.

l2s.name: Build & maintain roadmaps
l2s.description: Publish time-based portfolio/product/program roadmaps against releases and PIs at multiple levels.
l2s.config: Timeline/Roadmap views on Portfolio Epics/Epics/Features vs Releases/PIs, multi-level roadmaps
l2s.evidence: TP view modes; Solution Overview deck

l2s.name: Model scenarios & trade-offs
l2s.description: Evaluate alternative portfolio mixes (scope, timing, capacity, budget) and promote the chosen scenario to the plan of record. Scenario questions include capacity loss, feature slip, objective re-prioritization, approval delays, platform constraints and the financial impact of moving scope.
l2s.config: Scenario Planning solution (plan variants, promote scenario to baseline), demand vs capacity data, budget dashboards
l2s.framework: SPM: Portfolio Mgmt | SAFe: Participatory Budgeting
l2s.evidence: Customer PowerUp (scenario planning, baselines); TP solutions; PI Planning/EVD Agent requirements (IBM, anonymized) §8.4

l2s.name: Manage cross-initiative dependencies & risks
l2s.description: Identify, visualize and resolve dependencies and portfolio-level risks across initiatives and trains - including cross-ART/cross-portfolio dependencies, shared-service contention, platform bottlenecks, missing predecessors, insufficient lead time and aging dependencies.
l2s.config: Dependency/Impediment entities, relations, ART Planning Board, Risk Management solution; dependency graph & prioritized heatmap, dependency ownership & aging tracking
l2s.framework: SAFe: Program risks/ROAM | SPM: Portfolio Mgmt
l2s.evidence: TP entities; PI Planning solution; PI Planning/EVD Agent requirements (IBM, anonymized) §7.3, §11

l2s.name: Maintain one governed hybrid portfolio view
l2s.description: View and manage all work across hybrid programs - agile (epics/features from teams' tools) and waterfall projects - in a single governed environment with common categorization (BAU vs Change, CapEx/OpEx).
l2s.config: Hybrid portfolio views (agile + waterfall side by side), Hybrid Project Management solution, common work categorization fields, Jira/ADO sync for agile initiatives
l2s.framework: SPM: Hybrid Portfolio Mgmt (HPM solution area)
l2s.evidence: WFM deck (View all work across Hybrid Programs); Customer PowerUp (hybrid planning)
frameworks: SPM: Hybrid Portfolio Mgmt (HPM solution area)

l2s.name: Define funding model
l2s.description: Choose and configure project-based, product/value-stream (continuous) or hybrid funding with planning periods. Hybrid organizations typically run project-based and product-based funding side by side during transition. Where IT Finance runs ZBB (05.8), the value-stream envelope is the *change* budget that receives freed run spend - value streams are not themselves re-justified from zero.
l2s.config: Budgeting solution (annual or custom periods, value-stream funding), portfolio structure, budget guardrails by horizon/capacity/initiative
l2s.framework: SAFe: Lean Budgets | SPM: Financial Mgmt

variants.name: Define project-based funding
variants.description: Budgets are approved and tracked per project/initiative with annual planning periods; investment tags carry the project into Planning.
variants.config: Budgeting solution (project budgets, annual periods), project entities, investment tags (05.7.1)

variants.name: Define value-stream funding
variants.description: Fund value streams/ARTs as capacity envelopes with guardrails by horizon and initiative size; epics are approved inside envelopes. Where IT Finance runs ZBB (05.8) the envelope is the change budget that receives freed run spend.
variants.config: Budgeting solution (value-stream funding, custom periods), Portfolio/Group structure as value streams, Lean Budget guardrails

variants.description: Run project-based and value-stream funding side by side during transition, with common categorization (BAU vs change, CapEx/OpEx) so both reconcile to Planning.

l2s.name: Receive & apply top-down targets
l2s.description: Consume target spend/budget artifacts from IT Planning and apply them as portfolio budget targets (UC3 receive side). In a ZBB cycle the target carries the freed-spend uplift from 05.8.5.
l2s.config: Budget Targets report, target budget entities, ADM/data highway feed
l2s.framework: SPM: Financial Mgmt | TBM: Plan & Govern
l2s.evidence: E2E BPMN UC3; LFM demo (Target Budget from planning solution)

l2s.name: Track portfolio budget vs actuals
l2s.description: Compare proposed/funded budgets against costed work and actuals; adjust funding in-year.
l2s.config: Budget vs actuals dashboards, money custom fields, blended-rate costed work allocations, Budgeting view (Proposed Labor vs Target)
l2s.evidence: LFM demo; WFM deck Finance Manager activities

l2s.name: Define expected outcomes & value metrics
l2s.description: Set benefit hypotheses, KPIs and leading indicators for each funded investment.
l2s.config: KPI solution, key results on epics, money/number custom fields
l2s.framework: SPM: Value Realization | TBM: Delivering Value
l2s.evidence: SPM maturity model; TP KPI solution

l2s.name: Track realized value & feed decisions
l2s.description: Measure delivered outcomes vs hypothesis after release and feed results into ongoing funding and portfolio reviews.
l2s.config: KPI measurements, dashboards, Value Realization tab in leadership reporting, ROI/margin analysis
l2s.framework: SPM: Value Realization | TBM: four value conversations
l2s.evidence: WFM closed loop (Analyze & Act); LFM demo

l0s.name: Agile Program & Delivery Management
l0s.description: Plan and execute work on a PI and iteration cadence across ARTs, solution trains and teams, including hybrid/waterfall delivery, release management and value stream flow.

l2s.name: Assess & prepare quarterly planning readiness
l2s.description: Run readiness checks (PI/ART entities, objectives, features, team objectives, estimates, owners, dependencies, definition-of-ready) with a scored readiness verdict at team/ART/solution-train/portfolio level, resolution recommendations for each gap, and the 4-phase preparation plan.
l2s.personas: RTE/PI Coordinator, Product Owners, System Architect, Scrum Masters
l2s.config: PI & ART entities with dates, ART/Program PI Objectives, Team PI Objectives, features assigned to PI release, capacity fields (velocity = people x 8 rule; 80/20 allocation), PI Planning solution Pre-Plan views; readiness scoring & gap-resolution workflow (assign owner, add estimate, split feature, escalate decision), definition-of-ready rules
l2s.evidence: PI Planning Demo Script (readiness + 20-day plan); PI Planning solution 1.0.0; PI Planning/EVD Agent requirements (IBM, anonymized) §7.1-7.2

l2s.name: Run quarterly planning event
l2s.description: Facilitate big-room planning: teams plan features/stories into iterations, map dependencies, ROAM risks.
l2s.config: PI Planning Board, ART Planning Board (dependencies), Team Iteration assignment, WSJF-ordered features, risk entities
l2s.evidence: PI Planning solution; EAP CFD program mgmt 4-step

l2s.name: Commit & publish PI objectives
l2s.description: Finalize team/ART PI objectives with business value, confidence vote, and publish the program board.
l2s.config: Team PI Objectives (Committed/Stretch, confidence %, BV points), PI Dashboard, Program Board

l2s.name: Baseline commitments & track PI execution
l2s.description: Baseline what was committed at PI planning (objectives, features, capacity and funding assumptions, accepted risks, confidence results) as an auditable record, then continuously validate delivery against it - velocity, slippage, blocked dependencies, carryover, flow metrics - distinguishing normal variation from likely missed commitments; run system demos and RTE briefings.
l2s.config: PI Dashboard, dependency & risk boards, progress rollup metrics, burndown/CFD reports; commitment baseline snapshot, planned-vs-actual objective tracking, predictive ART health (flow time/efficiency/load, WIP, dependency aging), RTE/STE daily briefing views
l2s.evidence: TP reports; PI Planning solution Coordinate & Deliver views; PI Planning/EVD Agent requirements (IBM, anonymized) §9.1-9.4

l2s.name: Manage PI risks (ROAM) & confidence vote
l2s.description: Capture and classify program risks (Resolved/Owned/Accepted/Mitigated) with owners and mitigation actions, monitor aging and severity, and run the confidence vote - correlating votes with capacity, readiness and dependency data, and recording remediation when confidence is low.
l2s.outputs: ROAMed risk register, confidence results & remediation actions
l2s.config: Risk entities with ROAM classification fields, risk boards, owners & due dates, confidence-vote capture, risk aging/escalation automation rules
l2s.outcome: rOAMed risk register, confidence results & remediation actions

l2s.name: Run system demo & Inspect and Adapt
l2s.description: Prepare and run the system demo (demo candidates showing progress toward objectives, outcome summaries) and the Inspect & Adapt event - aggregating missed objectives, carryover, dependency failures, estimation variance and flow metrics into improvement themes with measurable actions.
l2s.config: Demo readiness views, PI metrics dashboards (predictability, flow, carryover), retrospective/improvement work items, pattern analysis (recurring dependency failures, chronic overcommitment)

l2s.name: Plan & execute iterations
l2s.description: Teams plan sprints/iterations and execute stories, bugs and tasks through their workflow.
l2s.config: Team Iteration entities, Scrum/Kanban team boards, story/bug/task workflows, estimation fields

variants.description: Teams plan sprints/iterations and execute stories, bugs and tasks on Targetprocess boards.
Teams plan and execute in Jira/ADO; iterations, states and estimates sync into Targetprocess Team Iterations so the portfolio sees progress without duplicate entry.
variants.config: Jira/ADO connectors (03.2.4), Team Iteration mapping, state/estimate mapping

l2s.name: Track flow & progress
l2s.description: Measure velocity, cycle/lead time, cumulative flow and rollups to features/epics/releases.
l2s.config: Velocity/burn/CFD/cycle-time reports, Metrics engine rollups, Forecast reports

l2s.name: Manage impediments & dependencies
l2s.description: Raise, track and resolve team-level impediments and cross-team dependencies.
l2s.config: Impediment/Dependency entities, boards, automation rule notifications

l2s.name: Sync with dev tools
l2s.description: Keep team-of-record tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Git) bi-directionally synced so ATP is the aggregation layer, not a duplicate.
l2s.config: Native Jira/ADO bi-directional connectors (issue-level, area/iteration path), Git/GitHub/GitLab via automation rules/webhooks
l2s.evidence: TP integrations; anti-pattern: no story-level Jira import to cost systems (e2e script)

l2s.name: Plan releases & enable release packages
l2s.description: Plan release scope/timing and manage release package enablement across trains.
l2s.config: Release/Planning Interval entities, Release Package Enablement solution

l2s.name: Manage hybrid & waterfall projects
l2s.description: Run traditional/hybrid projects (phases, milestones, Gantt) side-by-side with agile work in one governed portfolio.
l2s.config: Traditional/Hybrid Project Management solutions, timeline views, milestones, hybrid portfolio views

l2s.name: Govern stage-gates & milestones for traditional initiatives
l2s.description: Run phase-gate governance for waterfall/traditional initiatives: gate reviews as controlled state transitions, milestone tracking, and gate-approval evidence.
l2s.config: Entity states as gates with per-state role permissions, milestone entities, timeline/Gantt views, automation rules for gate notifications, Traditional Project Management solution
l2s.evidence: SPM/TP research (stage-gate vs lean funding); Traditional PM solution

l2s.name: Identify & map value streams
l2s.description: Define operational/development value streams and organize portfolios, ARTs and funding around them.
l2s.outputs: Value stream model in tool structure
l2s.config: ART/Group structure as value streams, value stream workshops (journey map), portfolio mapping
l2s.outcome: value stream model in tool structure

l2s.name: Measure & improve flow
l2s.description: Track value stream KPIs and flow metrics; run improvement actions.
l2s.config: Value stream KPIs (SAFe 6.0 solution), KPI solution, flow dashboards

l0s.name: Workforce & Resource Management
l0s.description: Maintain the workforce baseline (people, teams, involvements, job profiles), plan capacity against demand, allocate resources to work, govern position requests, and track time.

l2s.name: Load & maintain people roster
l2s.description: Establish the workforce baseline (employees, contractors, vendor service, consulting) from HR sources with per-source sync cadences.
l2s.config: People/Users entities, employee type (internal/external/contingent, on/offshore, billable), locations, skills; sync cadence per source (Client Zero: employees+contractors daily, consulting monthly, other manual)
l2s.framework: SPM: WFM (baseline) | TBM: labor cost pools
l2s.evidence: TBMC25 Load & Maintain People; WFM deck

l2s.name: Create & assign teams, ARTs & trains
l2s.description: Build the team-of-teams structure and assign people to teams with involvement percentages.
l2s.config: Team entities & hierarchy, ART/Solution Train, Involvements (% allocation, e.g. 50/75/100), team-project assignment
l2s.evidence: TBMC25 Create & Assign Teams; e2e script (involvements)

l2s.name: Maintain job profiles & financial mappings
l2s.description: Keep job profiles (role x location) mapped to rates and CapEx/OpEx splits, and teams mapped to IT towers - the three ingredients of the labor model.
l2s.outputs: Job profiles with rate & CapEx/OpEx mapping; team-tower mapping
l2s.config: Job Profile entities, CapEx/OpEx split mapping per profile, team->IT Tower mapping (fixed capacity rule), rate linkage (rates held in Costing)
l2s.evidence: E2E BPMN t_data; e2e script UC1 three ingredients
l2s.outcome: job profiles with rate & CapEx/OpEx mapping; team-tower mapping

variants.description: Keep job profiles (role x location) mapped to CapEx/OpEx splits and teams mapped to IT towers; rates stay in Costing and only blended team rates come back (UC2).
Keep job profiles (role x location) with a rate-card rate attached, CapEx/OpEx splits and team->tower mappings; the rate card is the published rate source.
variants.config: Job Profile entities with rate field (rate card), CapEx/OpEx split per profile, team->IT Tower mapping, annual rate-card refresh

l2s.name: Map & forecast capacity
l2s.description: Model capacity by function, role, location, level, skills, BU and domain across the planning horizon, integrating vacation/holiday schedules. Agile contexts plan capacity team-based; hybrid/traditional contexts plan role- and individual-based - model both.
l2s.config: Capacity dashboards, availability (total/reserved/available), Vacation Tracking solution feeding availability, regional calendars
l2s.evidence: SPM Framework WFM use cases; WFM deck capacity activities

variants.description: Model capacity per team/ART across the horizon (people x involvement x calendar); vacations reduce team availability.
Model capacity per role, location, level and skill and per named individual across the horizon, integrating vacation/holiday schedules.
Model team capacity for agile work and role/individual capacity for project work in one model; involvements must sum to 100% per person.

l2s.name: Balance demand vs capacity
l2s.description: Compare bottom-up demand rollups against available capacity and targets; resolve over/under allocation (e.g. 'three months out, demand exceeds FTE').
l2s.inputs: Work allocations/demand, capacity model, target spend
l2s.config: Demand & Capacity Mgmt solution (Work Allocation entity %/hours/man-days, auto-generated Demand per period, load reports, demand processing screens), capacity/FTE reports vs targets
l2s.evidence: E2E BPMN t_cmp; TP Demand & Capacity solution

l2s.name: Run workforce scenarios
l2s.description: Model alternative workforce/demand scenarios (mix, location, hiring) and promote decisions into plans.
l2s.config: Scenario planning (workforce scenarios, labor availabilities generation), HC scenario views

l2s.name: Allocate people & teams to work
l2s.description: Assign users, teams, ARTs and solution trains to portfolio work at any hierarchy level (bottom-up demand).
l2s.config: Work Allocation entities, allocation timelines, team-to-work assignment at any level
l2s.evidence: E2E BPMN t_alloc; LFM demo work allocations

variants.description: Assign teams, ARTs and solution trains to portfolio work at any hierarchy level (bottom-up demand as team %).
Assign named individuals and roles to projects with requested man-days/hours (see 04.3.4).
Assign teams to agile work and individuals/roles to project work in the same Work Allocation model.

l2s.name: Track utilization & productivity
l2s.description: Compare planned vs actual utilization; monitor bottlenecks and efficiency by role/location/team.
l2s.config: Resource Management Dashboard, Team Load report, Efficiency tab (completed items & effort MoM)

l2s.name: Match skills & close gaps
l2s.description: Compare work demand to skills supply; identify hiring/upskilling needs.
l2s.config: Skills fields, capacity by skill views, gap reports

l2s.name: Assign individuals & roles to project work (hybrid resourcing)
l2s.description: For traditional/hybrid work, assign named individuals or roles to projects with requested man-days - alongside team-based allocation used for agile work - so one capacity model covers both.
l2s.outputs: Individual/role assignments in the same capacity model
l2s.config: Work Allocations (person-level man-days/hours), role-based demand requests, New Requested Demand workflow, availability integration
l2s.evidence: LFM demo (requested man-days from individuals/teams); WFM deck
l2s.outcome: individual/role assignments in the same capacity model

l2s.name: Create position requests
l2s.description: Raise governed requests for new positions (role, location, hours, type, department link to the finance budget line).
l2s.config: Position Request entity (role, location, hours, employment type, department link)
l2s.evidence: E2E BPMN t_pos; e2e script UC3

l2s.name: Approve positions (multi-level workflow)
l2s.description: Route position requests through HR > Department > Final approval with notifications, dependencies and escalations; reject or approve.
l2s.config: Multi-level approval workflow (entity states + per-state permissions), automation rules (notifications, escalations), XOR outcome

l2s.name: Sync approved positions to Planning & auto-update on fill
l2s.description: Send only approved positions across the data highway to IT Planning for budgeting; when filled in ATP the Planning record updates automatically.
l2s.config: ADM/data highway position feed, open vs filled normalization in Planning, auto-update linkage
l2s.evidence: E2E BPMN t_send2/t_norm; e2e script round-trip

l2s.name: Capture effort against work
l2s.description: Establish the effort record for each team according to the labor effort signal chosen (D-01): recorded hours, completed work from the backlog, confirmed work allocations, or nothing for fixed-capacity teams.
l2s.config: Depends on D-01: Time entity + Time Tracking solution (timesheets) or backlog/allocation data (no timesheets)
l2s.evidence: TP Time Tracking; Timesheet solution sheet; LFM demo

variants.name: Use completed work as the effort signal
variants.description: No time is recorded. The completed stories/features on the team backlog are the effort signal; involvements and rates supply the cost. Estimate vs remaining stays on the work item for planning only.
variants.config: No Time entity for these teams; backlog hygiene rules (every story estimated, closed in-period); Jira/ADO sync of story points
variants.inputs: Completed work items with story points
variants.outputs: Completed-work data per team per month

variants.name: Use completed items as the effort signal
variants.description: As story points, but the count of completed work items is the signal - no estimation required.
variants.config: No Time entity; closed-item rules per period
variants.outputs: Item counts per team per month

variants.name: Record hours on timesheets
variants.description: Team members log hours against work items or projects daily/weekly in the Time entity; billable flags and estimate vs actual vs remaining are captured for each entry.
variants.config: Time entity, Time Tracking solution, timesheet views, billable/non-billable fields, reminders/compliance report

variants.name: Maintain work allocations as the effort record
variants.description: Planned Work Allocations (% or man-days per person/team per period) stand in for recorded effort; owners confirm or adjust them at period end instead of logging hours.
variants.config: Work Allocation entities (%, hours, man-days), period-end confirmation view, true-up rule

variants.name: No effort capture (fixed capacity)
variants.description: Nothing is recorded at work level; the team's cost is attributed by a standing team->tower/app rule downstream (06.4.5).
variants.config: None in Targetprocess beyond team membership

l2s.name: Approve timesheets
l2s.description: Managers review and approve weekly timesheets under governance rules.
l2s.config: Timesheet approval workflow (solution component), notifications
l2s.evidence: 2026.03 Timesheet with Approval Workflow solution sheet; Solution Overview (time recording)

variants.description: Managers review and approve weekly timesheets under governance rules; unapproved time is chased before the month closes.

l2s.name: Feed time/effort to finance processes
l2s.description: Deliver the effort record chosen in D-01 (approved hours, completed work, confirmed allocations or roster only) to capitalization, costing and billing over the ADM feed.
l2s.config: Time reports/exports, ADM feed to Costing, story-point/completed-work alternative (deprecates time writing)
l2s.evidence: E2E script UC1 payoff; Costing labor allocation options

variants.name: Feed completed work to Costing
variants.description: Send completed work (story points by epic/feature/app) with involvements and job profiles to Costing over ADM; time writing is deprecated for these teams.
variants.config: ADM feed ATP->TBM Studio: completed-work dataset (points, weightage) + workforce data

decisions.name: Labor effort signal
decisions.question: How is labor effort captured and attached to work so it can be costed, capitalized and rolled into App TCO?
decisions.why: Drives which Targetprocess entities carry effort, what crosses the ADM feed to Costing, how team cost is spread over work and towers, and what the auditors see behind the CapEx file. Most customers mix approaches by team kind (e.g. story points for product teams, fixed capacity for ops queues), so this decision is normally made per team type.

options.name: Cost per story point
options.summary: Monthly team cost divided by story points completed gives a cost per point; cost lands on epics, features and applications in proportion to the points delivered against them. Effort is never typed in - it comes from the backlog.
options.fit: Agile teams with a visible, well-groomed backlog in Targetprocess or a synced Jira/ADO. The Apptio reference pattern ('deprecates time writing').
options.prereqs: Involvements % (04.1.2), job profiles with CapEx/OpEx split (04.1.3), protected rates (06.4.1), completed-work feed to Costing (UC1), a capitalization policy signed off with Finance/audit.
options.tradeoffs: Points are only comparable within a team - always normalize per team, never enterprise-wide. Un-estimated or carried-over work distorts the month. Needs backlog hygiene and a documented policy for auditors.
options.evidence: E2E BPMN g_vis/t_work; e2e script UC1

options.name: Cost per completed work item
options.summary: Same mechanism as story points but every completed story/work item weighs the same. Team cost divided by items done.
options.fit: Kanban / no-estimates teams, support and enhancement teams whose items are of similar size.
options.prereqs: As story points, minus estimation discipline.
options.tradeoffs: A one-line fix and a two-week story cost the same; acceptable only where item sizes are homogeneous.

options.name: Timesheets (hours x rate)
options.summary: People log hours against work items or projects in the Time entity; managers approve weekly; approved hours x rate is the labor cost attached to work and the basis for CapEx.
options.fit: Traditional and hybrid delivery, professional-services and contractor billing, regulated environments that require hours as the capitalization evidence, or where Finance already runs a timesheet regime.
options.prereqs: Time Tracking solution + Timesheet approval workflow (04.5.1-04.5.2), rate source (job-profile or blended rate), timesheet compliance reporting.
options.tradeoffs: Highest burden and the classic accuracy decay (end-of-week estimates, 'other' buckets). Needs chasing and compliance metrics. Strongest audit trail.
options.evidence: TP Time Tracking; 2026.03 Timesheet with Approval Workflow solution sheet

options.name: Planned work-effort units (allocation-based)
options.summary: Work Allocations (% or man-days per person/team per period) are treated as the effort signal; no hours are recorded. Cost = allocation x rate, trued up periodically against actual completion.
options.fit: Hybrid organizations that plan resourcing carefully but will not run timesheets; project-based funding where the plan is the contract.
options.prereqs: Demand & Capacity solution with Work Allocations (04.3.1 / 04.3.4), a true-up rule (quarterly or at project close), blended rates (UC2).
options.tradeoffs: Planned is not actual - variance hides until true-up. Weaker capitalization evidence than hours; usually paired with a sign-off step.

options.name: Fixed capacity (team to tower/app)
options.summary: No work-level attribution at all: the team's monthly cost is allocated to applications or IT towers by a standing rule (team->tower mapping, % splits).
options.fit: Run/operations teams without a visible backlog (ServiceNow queues, infrastructure ops, service desk), platform teams charged as shared services.
options.prereqs: Team->IT tower / application mapping (04.1.3), allocation strategy in Model Studio (06.1.2).
options.tradeoffs: No run-vs-change split from data; capitalization only via a fixed % if policy allows. Simplest to operate.
options.evidence: E2E BPMN t_tower; e2e script (ServiceNow example)

decisions.name: Labor rate exposure
decisions.question: Which labor rate is allowed to leave Costing and be used in Targetprocess to cost work?
decisions.why: Individual compensation is sensitive; the level at which rates are blended sets who can see what, how accurate costed allocations are, and whether a true-up is needed between the rate used in the portfolio and actuals in Costing.

options.name: Blended team / ART rate
options.summary: Costing computes one blended rate per team, ART or solution train from protected individual rates and publishes only that. Portfolio costs work at the team rate.
options.fit: Most enterprises; the Apptio reference pattern.
options.prereqs: Team structure with involvements (04.1.2), ATP CM Rate Transform (06.4.1), ADM rate feed (06.4.2).
options.tradeoffs: Costed allocations drift from actuals when team mix changes - define a true-up (monthly or quarterly).
options.evidence: E2E BPMN t_rates/t_send4; e2e script UC2

options.name: Job-profile rate (role x location)
options.summary: Standard rate card per job profile (role x location, optionally employment type) published to Targetprocess; individuals inherit their profile's rate.
options.fit: Organizations with a mature rate card, project-based estimating, PS/contractor mixes, or where teams are too fluid to blend.
options.prereqs: Job Profile entities with rate linkage (04.1.3), rate card governance (annual refresh).
options.tradeoffs: More granular than a team rate and still non-identifying, but a rate card needs owning and refreshing.
options.evidence: E2E BPMN t_data; Planning labor rate cards (05.7.2)

options.name: Individual (actual) rates
options.summary: Actual loaded cost per person leaves Costing and is used to cost allocations and time.
options.fit: Small IT organizations, PS firms, or where Finance already exposes comp to project accounting.
options.prereqs: Restricted-access roles in Targetprocess, HR/works-council approval, field-level permissions.
options.tradeoffs: Most accurate, but exposes compensation in a delivery tool; usually blocked by HR/privacy. Not the default.

decisions.name: Budget build method
decisions.question: How is the IT budget built for a given decision unit and cycle?
decisions.why: Sets whether 05.1 or 05.8 is the path for a cost center, tower, service or application, how the baseline is seeded, and whether the ZBB flow runs. Selectable per decision unit and per cycle - a rotation is the normal pattern.

options.name: Incremental
options.summary: Prior-year budget or actuals seeded as the baseline, adjusted line by line for known changes.
options.fit: Stable run units between ZBB rotations; low-effort cycles.
options.prereqs: Prior plan / actuals import (05.1.1).
options.tradeoffs: Carries last year's inefficiencies forward; weakest challenge of the run base.

options.name: Driver-based
options.summary: Lines are built from drivers (headcount, contracts, assets, volumes) with rates; the baseline is regenerated from drivers rather than copied.
options.fit: The default for most units; pairs with rolling forecasting (05.2).
options.prereqs: Driver data (positions, contracts, asset register), driver-based line items in Planning.
options.tradeoffs: Needs clean driver feeds; still anchored on current activity levels.

options.name: Zero-based - rotational
options.summary: A subset of decision units is rebuilt from a zero base each cycle (each unit every 2-3 years); the rest run driver-based. Decision packages at Minimum / Current / Enhanced tiers, ranked to a cut-line.
options.fit: Organizations that want the challenge of ZBB without the annual burden. The catalog's primary ZBB variant.
options.prereqs: Group 05.8, cost-category owners, TBM fact base (06.x), rotation calendar (10.6.1).
options.tradeoffs: Two budgeting paths in one cycle; needs the merge step 05.8.5.

options.name: Zero-based - all units annually
options.summary: Classic ZBB: every decision unit justified from zero every year.
options.fit: Turnaround / cost-out programs with executive mandate.
options.prereqs: As rotational, at full scale; FP&A facilitation capacity.
options.tradeoffs: The historical failure mode (burden, sandbagging); rarely sustained beyond 2-3 cycles.

options.name: Zero-based mindset (continuous)
options.summary: No annual ZBB event; cost-category owners run a continuous zero-based review inside the monthly rhythm (05.8.6 as an operating cadence).
options.fit: Organizations past their first ZBB cycles that want to keep the discipline without the event.
options.prereqs: Monthly variance with package-level thresholds (05.3.2 / 06.2.2), owner community.
options.tradeoffs: Depends on culture and incentives; without the event the challenge can fade.

decisions.name: Portfolio funding model
decisions.question: Is change work funded per project, per value stream/product, or both during a transition?
decisions.why: Decides the shape of the Budgeting solution in Targetprocess, whether budgets attach to Projects or to Portfolios/ARTs, what the investment loop with Planning carries, and how top-down targets are applied.

options.name: Project-based funding
options.summary: Money is approved per project/initiative with a business case and a defined scope; actuals are tracked per project.
options.fit: Traditional and regulated PMOs, capital-project cultures, organizations early on the SPM journey.
options.prereqs: Project entities with budgets, stage-gate governance (D-05), investment tags in Planning (05.7.1).
options.tradeoffs: Re-planning is slow; funding follows projects rather than capacity; encourages large batches.

options.name: Value-stream / product funding (Lean Budgets)
options.summary: Capacity is funded per value stream, ART or product with guardrails; epics are approved inside the envelope, not funded individually.
options.fit: SAFe / LPM organizations, product operating models.
options.prereqs: Value streams as Portfolios/Groups (03.4.1), Lean Budget guardrails (02.4.1), participatory budgeting forums.
options.tradeoffs: Finance must accept capacity-based accounting; capitalization moves to the labor model (D-01).
options.evidence: SAFe Lean Budgets; TP Budgeting solution

options.name: Hybrid (both, side by side)
options.summary: Project-based and value-stream funding coexist - typically during a multi-year transition or where some domains stay project-shaped.
options.fit: Most large enterprises today.
options.prereqs: Common categorization (BAU vs change, CapEx/OpEx) across both (02.3.4), Hybrid Portfolio Management solution.
options.tradeoffs: Two governance paths to keep consistent; reporting must reconcile both.

decisions.name: Investment approval governance
decisions.question: How does an investment get approved - phase gates, lean portfolio flow, or both?
decisions.why: Shapes entity workflows and per-state permissions in Targetprocess, which forums decide, and whether Portfolio Kanban states or gate reviews are the control points.

options.name: Stage-gate
options.summary: Initiatives pass formal gates (concept, business case, design, build, deploy) with documented approvals and criteria at each.
options.fit: Traditional PMOs, regulated change, capital projects.
options.prereqs: Entity states as gates with role permissions, milestone entities, gate evidence fields (03.3.3).
options.tradeoffs: Predictable control, slow flow; encourages big up-front business cases.

options.name: Lean portfolio flow (Portfolio Kanban)
options.summary: Epics move Funnel > Reviewing > Analyzing > Backlog > Implementing with WIP limits; approval is the move to Backlog within the value-stream guardrails.
options.fit: SAFe / LPM organizations with value-stream funding.
options.prereqs: Portfolio Epic workflow, WSJF or scoring (D-06), Lean Budgets (D-04).
options.tradeoffs: Needs trust in guardrails; auditors may want an explicit approval artifact.

options.name: Hybrid
options.summary: Gates for large/regulated initiatives, lean flow for value-stream work - one governed portfolio view over both.
options.fit: Enterprises running agile and traditional delivery together.
options.prereqs: Hybrid Portfolio Management solution, common categorization (02.3.4).
options.tradeoffs: Clear rules needed for which path an item takes.

decisions.name: Prioritization method
decisions.question: How is the portfolio backlog ranked?
decisions.why: Determines which custom and calculated fields exist on epics, what the ranking views show and how ZBB packages are ranked when 05.8 runs.

options.name: WSJF
options.summary: Cost of delay (business value + time criticality + risk reduction/opportunity enablement) divided by job size, as a calculated field.
options.fit: SAFe organizations; fast, relative ranking.
options.prereqs: Numeric custom fields BV/TC/RR-OE/size, calculated field or metric, prioritized list views (02.2.2).
options.tradeoffs: Relative, gameable, weak for compliance/mandatory work.

options.name: Weighted objective scoring
options.summary: Configurable criteria (strategic alignment, value, risk, cost, compliance) with weights; a score per item; often per portfolio.
options.fit: Hybrid and traditional portfolios; organizations that must show a defensible model to a board.
options.prereqs: Scoring custom fields, Portfolio Epic Score report, objective-scoring configuration.
options.tradeoffs: Weights need governance; can become a spreadsheet exercise.
options.evidence: WFM deck prioritization; TP Portfolio Epic Score

options.name: Manual / forum ranking
options.summary: A governance forum ranks items by hand (drag-order or rank field) informed by business cases.
options.fit: Small portfolios, early maturity.
options.prereqs: Rank/order field, prioritized list views.
options.tradeoffs: Opaque; depends on who is in the room.

decisions.name: Capacity planning basis
decisions.question: Is capacity planned and allocated per team, per role/named individual, or both?
decisions.why: Decides whether Work Allocations attach to teams or people, how demand is expressed (team % vs role man-days) and which capacity views and reports are configured.

options.name: Team-based
options.summary: Long-lived teams are the unit of capacity; work is allocated to teams and ARTs by % or PI capacity.
options.fit: Agile at scale; value-stream funding.
options.prereqs: Team entities with involvements (04.1.2), team allocation views.
options.tradeoffs: Named-resource requests (specialists) have no home.

options.name: Role / individual-based
options.summary: Demand is expressed as roles and man-days; named individuals are assigned to projects with availability checks.
options.fit: Project-based PMOs, PS organizations, shared specialist pools.
options.prereqs: Role-based demand requests, Work Allocations at person level, availability / vacation integration (04.3.4).
options.tradeoffs: Heavier to maintain; utilization chasing.

options.name: Both (one capacity model)
options.summary: Team-based for agile work and role/individual-based for project work in the same capacity model.
options.fit: Hybrid organizations - the common case.
options.prereqs: Both configurations plus a rule for which work type uses which.
options.tradeoffs: Double-counting risk where a person is both in a team and on a project - involvements must sum to 100%.

decisions.name: Demand intake channel
decisions.question: Where do ideas and requests enter - the Targetprocess Service Desk, a ServiceNow front end, or email/forms?
decisions.why: Sets which portal is configured, whether an integration is needed, and where triage happens.

options.name: Targetprocess Service Desk portal
options.summary: Requesters use the built-in portal; Request entities and request types with voting.
options.fit: Organizations standardizing on Targetprocess for intake.
options.prereqs: Service Desk portal, Request entity + types, automation rules for routing (02.1.1-02.1.2).
options.tradeoffs: Another portal for business users if ServiceNow already exists.

options.name: ServiceNow ideation / demand front end
options.summary: Ideas are raised in ServiceNow; an integration creates Requests/epics in Targetprocess for qualification.
options.fit: ServiceNow-centric enterprises.
options.prereqs: ServiceNow integration (10.1.5), field mapping, status sync.
options.tradeoffs: Two systems of record for the early lifecycle; sync rules matter.

options.name: Email / forms
options.summary: Requests arrive by email or a form and are created by automation or a triage team.
options.fit: Small volumes, interim state.
options.prereqs: Email integration, automation rules.
options.tradeoffs: Low structure; manual triage.

decisions.name: Cloud commitment management mode
decisions.question: Are reserved-instance / savings-plan / CUD commitments managed by hand, assisted by recommendations, or automated?
decisions.why: Decides whether 07.5.3 or 07.5.4 is the operating process, what guardrails and roles are configured, and how Finance approves commitments.

options.name: Manual (vendor consoles)
options.summary: Commitments are bought in the cloud vendor consoles on a periodic review; Cloudability reports coverage.
options.fit: Small cloud spend; early FinOps maturity (Crawl).
options.prereqs: Commitment Overview reports.
options.tradeoffs: Under-coverage and expiry misses are common.

options.name: Assisted (recommendations + approval)
options.summary: Cloudability generates purchase/exchange recommendations; FinOps and Finance approve and execute.
options.fit: Most organizations (Walk).
options.prereqs: Commitment Recommendations, approval forum, procurement alignment (07.5.3).
options.tradeoffs: Human latency; coverage typically 70-85%.

options.name: Automated (Savings Automation)
options.summary: Commitment portfolio managed on autopilot within per-account / per-region guardrails; savings-share billing.
options.fit: Large, steady AWS/Azure estates (Run).
options.prereqs: RateOptimizationFullAccess role, guardrail configuration (07.5.4 / 10.4.2), Finance sign-off on savings-share.
options.tradeoffs: Governance shifts to guardrails; commercial model to accept.

decisions.name: IT cost recovery model
decisions.question: Does IT show costs back, charge them back at allocated cost, or charge priced services with over/under recovery?
decisions.why: Sets whether the Billing product is needed, whether a price list and O/U recovery process exist, and how BU conversations are framed.

options.name: Showback
options.summary: BUs receive a Bill of IT for information; no journal entries.
options.fit: First years of TBM; where BU budgets do not carry IT cost.
options.prereqs: BU allocation (08.1.1), Bill of IT reports (08.1.2).
options.tradeoffs: Influences behavior less than real charges.

options.name: Chargeback at allocated cost
options.summary: Allocated cost is journaled to BU cost centers each period; full recovery by construction.
options.fit: Organizations with BU P&L accountability.
options.prereqs: Billing product or GL journal export, agreed drivers, dispute process.
options.tradeoffs: Charges fluctuate with allocation changes; BUs contest drivers.

options.name: Chargeback at service prices
options.summary: Services are priced (unit rates from 06.3.4); BUs are charged consumption x price; IT manages over/under recovery.
options.fit: Mature TBM with a service catalog; shared-service models.
options.prereqs: Service unit costs, pricing strategy and what-if modeling, O/U recovery management (08.1.3).
options.tradeoffs: Pricing governance and recovery variance to manage; strongest demand shaping.

decisions.name: Team tool of record
decisions.question: Do teams work in Targetprocess natively, or in Jira / Azure DevOps synced into Targetprocess as the aggregation layer?
decisions.why: Decides which connectors exist, where iteration planning happens and what completed-work data is available for the labor model.

options.name: Targetprocess native
options.summary: Teams plan iterations and execute stories in Targetprocess boards.
options.fit: Greenfield or consolidating tool estates.
options.prereqs: Team boards, story/bug/task workflows (03.2.1).
options.tradeoffs: Migration of team habits and history.

options.name: Jira / ADO synced
options.summary: Teams stay in Jira or Azure DevOps; native bi-directional connectors keep Targetprocess as the aggregation layer for portfolio and finance.
options.fit: Most enterprises with established engineering tooling.
options.prereqs: Native connectors, area/iteration path mapping, hierarchy rules (03.2.4).
options.tradeoffs: Mapping governance; do not import story-level detail into cost systems.
